title: Ai evaluation engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai evaluation engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About First Ignite First Ignite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at First Ignite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the Open AI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Open AI Evals, Deep Eval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, Lang Graph, Open AI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs. Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy. As part of your Linked In application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of. Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Banco de talentos - atendimento
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Banco de talentos - atendimento em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. A Bahiana é uma instituição de direito privado, sem fins econômicos, de caráter educacional, cultural, científico e assistencial, com foco no ensino, na pesquisa e na extensão dos conhecimentos e serviços próprios da área de saúde, das ciências em geral e da cultura para oferecer à comunidade. Seu principal objetivo é formar profissionais qualificados com base em valores éticos e humanísticos . Em mais de 70 anos de história , já diplomou mais de 17 mil profissionais da área de saúde. Além disso, é uma Escola nota 5, a nota máxima na avaliação do MEC que menos de 3% das instituições de ensino no Brasil, entre públicas e particulares, possuem . Recentemente, a Bahiana ganhou, pelo sexto ano consecutivo, o prêmio Great Place To Work (GPTW) , premiação global atribuída às empresas que, de acordo com os seus funcionários, são os melhores lugares para trabalhar. Permanecemos no 1º lugar no ranking das melhores empresas para trabalhar na Bahia. Em sua grade, a Bahiana possui cursos de graduação em Medicina, Fisioterapia, Odontologia, Psicologia, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, Educação Física e Tecnólogo em Informática em Saúde, este na modalidade de Educação a Distância. Além da graduação, são mais de 25 cursos de Especialização, Mestrado e Doutorado, sem contar os mais de 20 programas sociais e os cursos de Extensão. Para além da educação em saúde, a Bahiana Saúde, que abarca o Centro Médico e o Centro Odontológico da Bahiana, presta serviços de saúde à população , contando com o Ambulatório da Comunidade, com as Clínicas de Psicologia e Fisioterapia e com a Clínica Odontológica, além de mais atendimentos em diversas áreas de saúde. Trabalhar na Bahiana é ter o que chamamos de "Bahianidade na veia" . É compartilhar dos nossos valores de Servir, Empreender, Comunicar, Aprender e ensinar . É por isso que queremos agregar talentos que valorizem a nossa tradição , mas que, como a instituição, mirem no futuro, na inovação e no trabalho  para a construção de um mundo no qual a saúde seja valorizada como um direito básico e universal. /n
Experiência com atendimento ao público; Vontade de se desenvolver; Desejo de aprender e ensinar; Apreço pelas relações interpessoais; Interesse em fazer parte da Bahiana! /nReceberemos o seu currículo e guardaremos no nosso Banco de Talentos para que possa ser utilizado em vagas que correspondam ao seu perfil.

title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Mobile Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.


Key Responsibilities

  • CrossPlatform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native
  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
  • Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce SmartStore and SmartSync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
  • Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using OpenCV within the mobile environment
  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
  • Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
  • Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI
  • Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native JavaScriptTypeScript
  • Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
  • State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
  • Computer Vision: Experience integrating OpenCV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
  • Version Control: Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Gitbased collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in SwiftObjectiveC iOS or JavaKotlin Android
  • Hyperscaler Exposure: Experience connecting mobile apps to GCPAzure backend services Cloud Run App Services
  • Salesforce Platform: Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC
  • Mobile Security: Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns
  • FMCG Domain: Understanding of retail execution van sales or fieldforce automation workflows

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Web3 & Al Investment Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Business Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. Highly Desirable Skills

Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.

  • Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets.
  • Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs.
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns.
  • Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools.
  • Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment.

  • Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives.

  • Experience with AWS and working with databases.
  • Experience with SDUI and CI/CD.
  • Experience with flutter_bloc.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

description:

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.


Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.


If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Chiniese-Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator（Mandarin required））
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Chiniese-Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator（Mandarin required）） em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role: We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator to join our international team. This role serves as the critical bridge between our Chinese headquarters and our local operations in Brazil. It is a unique opportunity not only to utilize your language skills but also to grow into a project management or regional operations role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Mandarin Interpretation & Translation: Provide high-quality consecutive interpretation (Mandarin ↔ Brazilian Portuguese) for board meetings, business negotiations, and technical site visits.
  • Document Management: Translate project documents, contracts, and technical specifications from Chinese to Portuguese and vice versa .
  • On-site Coordination: Act as the primary linguistic link between Chinese expatriates and the local Brazilian workforce to ensure cultural alignment and operational efficiency.
  • Operational Support: Assist HR, Finance, and Admin departments in interfacing with local entities using your bilingual skills.
  • Project Growth: Take on project management tasks as your understanding of our Chinese-Brazilian operations deepens.

Qualifications (Mandarin is Essential):

  • Language Proficiency (Mandatory): Native or professional-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese (HSK 4 or equivalent) and Brazilian Portuguese. (English is a plus)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • Experience: Proven experience in Chinese-Portuguese interpretation/translation. Candidates who have studied or worked in China are highly preferred.
  • Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical concepts between Chinese and Brazilian teams.
  • Mindset: Strong sense of responsibility and willingness to work on-site (Expat/Stationed) with the Chinese team.

What We Offer (Benefits & Welfare):

  • Competitive Package: Social Insurance &Accommodation provided + Overseas Allowance.
  • Home Leave: 1-2 times per year (Total 28 days), with round-trip international airfare fully covered by the company.
  • Holidays & Gifts: Observance of Brazilian statutory holidays + Benefits for birthdays and traditional festivals (gifts, celebrations, etc.).
  • Accommodation: Corporate housing provided.

Career Growth: This is a developmental role with a clear career path. Top performers will have the opportunity to be promoted to core positions in Project Management or Regional Operations .

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Gerente de Technical Advisor (GIS / ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Analista de Redes Pleno (CCNP/Cisco ACI)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Redes Pleno (CCNP/Cisco ACI) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!

Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética.


Buscamos pessoa Analista de Redes Pleno para atuar de forma remota, alocado em cliente de alta complexidade.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Realizar suporte de alto nível com as seguintes atribuições: Resolução de problemas, Configuração, aprovisionamento, abertura de gestão de mudanças, geração de relatórios, análise e correção de falhas e desempenho em redes LAN Datacenter.
  • Analisar e corrigir problemas de configuração em equipamentos de redes de dados, quando ocorrer falha em implantações de servidores, aplicações e serviços em Data Center.
  • Realizar análises das demandas internas e reuniões de esclarecimento de

demandas com o cliente solicitante, caso necessário.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência consolidada no suporte de redes LAN
  • Certificação CCNP ENTERPRISE ou CCNP DATACENTER válida
  • Experiência com tecnologias: Cisco ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure), Switches Nexus em modo ACI com controladora SDN (APIC), Nexus Dashboard (Cisco Nexus Dashboard Insights) e Cisco Multi-Site Orchestrator (MSO) e modelos de Catalyst Cisco 9200
  • Inglês técnico – Abertura de chamado e interação com fabricante



Como você pode se destacar?

  • Certificação ITILv4
  • Conhecimento em outros linhas de equipamentos Cisco, Extreme/Enterasys e Brocade;


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Especialista em Sistemas Corporativos - Turismo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em Sistemas Corporativos - Turismo em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos o ecossistema de turismo mais transformador na vida de cada pessoa! A paixão por viagens está em nosso DNA.


Nossos escritórios proporcionam um ambiente moderno e pensado para uma melhor experiência de trabalho presencial. Somos múltiplos e diversos, gostamos de trabalhar com gente do bem, de forma inteligente, prática, ousada, inovadora e com tudo isso, buscamos o extraordinário.


O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável! Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?


#VemSerBeFly


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar como referência funcional e evolutiva do ERP Benner Turismo, garantindo estabilidade operacional, evolução do produto e alinhamento entre negócio, tecnologia e fornecedores. Papel híbrido, com forte atuação como Product Owner, priorizando backlog, melhorias e entregas de valor.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Ser o ponto focal do ERP Benner (módulos financeiros, faturamento, conciliação, backoffice e integrações).
  • Atuar como Product Owner do produto, com gestão de backlog, priorização e roadmap.
  • Levantar e traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros.
  • Conduzir refinamentos, homologações e apoiar testes (UAT).
  • Garantir qualidade das entregas, estabilidade e aderência aos processos do negócio.
  • Interface direta com áreas usuárias, fornecedores (Benner) e times técnicos.
  • Apoiar projetos de automação, melhorias contínuas e integrações (APIs, arquivos, RPA).
  • Monitorar indicadores, riscos e impactos operacionais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com ERP Benner (preferencialmente Benner Turismo).
  • Vivência em áreas financeiras/administrativas e processos de backoffice.
  • Atuação prévia ou forte aderência ao papel de Product Owner.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de priorização.
  • Perfil hands-on, colaborativo e orientado a entrega.
  • Experiência com projetos, backlog, indicadores e condução de demandas com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Desejável conhecimento em Power BI, integrações e automação de processos


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFly?


  • VR iFood Benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Estacionamento na sede | Desconto exclusivo para colaboradores.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.


E muito mais!

title: Senior Angular Developer (Angular and Electron)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Angular Developer (Angular and Electron) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Intellias , we're always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our team in Colombia. Over 20 years of market experience, Intellias brings together technologists, creators and innovators in Europe, North and Latin America, and the Middle East. Join our international team and take the mission to solve the advanced tech challenges of tomorrow!


If you're enthusiastic about contributing your skills and experience to our organization, we invite you to submit your CV for this position.


What we offer you in Intellias

  • B2B Contract
  • Fixed hour-based salary. You should have a private entrepreneurs (PE) and open US dollar bank account.
  • Corporate courses (Udemy, LinkedIn Learning and O'Raily)
  • Technical equipment on request
  • 100% English environment


Requirements:


  • English B2/C1
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development
  • Highly Proficient in Angular 20, TypeScript, JavaScript, ES8+, HTML5, CSS3.
  • Proficient in test-driven development, automated testing, and the use of testing frameworks
  • Experience with Less/Sass CSS Pre-processors
  • Experience in the area of modular and scalable software development
  • Experience maintaining a living and complex codebase with a modern stack
  • Designing and developing reusable, testable front end components
  • Desire to learn cutting edge technology to solve complex business problems
  • Experience with Electron, Webpack, NodeJS, Vue.js, NPM, SVG


Responsabilities


  • Develop and maintain modern web solutions as a Senior Engineer within the Web Team using Angular 18, JavaScript, TypeScript (ES8+), HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable UI components for web and desktop platforms, including Web, Windows, and macOS applications.
  • Establish and uphold high‑quality, maintainable, and performant coding standards , ensuring consistency across multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA teams, and UX designers to deliver new features and enhancements for next‑generation applications.
  • Contribute to architecture design, technical decisions, design patterns, and development best practices .
  • Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing .
  • Drive continuous improvement in frontend architecture, performance, and user experience .
  • Own features from concept and design through implementation and delivery , ensuring alignment with both business and technical goals .

title: Full Stack Engineer (Laravel, Redux, and TypeScript)
description:

DomainTools is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Internal Team.   • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
